I am fortunate to work with an excellent group of students who bring curiosity, care, and a wide range of backgrounds to our research. They lead much of the lab's work, from designing and building systems to studying how people use them in classrooms and communities, and many have presented their research at leading conferences in human–computer interaction and computing education.
